options.name: configuration_volume
options.description: Partition configuration volume size in GB.

options.name: images_volume
options.description: Partition images volume size in GB

options.name: ipv4_mgmt_address
options.description: Specifies the IPv4 address and subnet or subnet mask you use to access the chassis partition. When creating a new chassis partition, if the CIDR notation is not used, a default of C(/24) is appended to the address. The address must be specified in CIDR notation e.g. 192.168.1.1/24.

options.name: ipv4_mgmt_gateway
options.description: Chassis partition management gateway. The value C(none) can be used during an update to remove this value.

options.name: ipv6_mgmt_address
options.description: Specifies the IPv6 address and subnet or subnet mask that you use to access the chassis partition. When creating a new chassis partition, if the CIDR notation is not used a default of C(/96) is appended to the address. The address must be specified in CIDR notation e.g. 2002::1234:abcd:ffff:c0a8:101/64.

options.name: ipv6_mgmt_gateway
options.description: Chassis partition management gateway. The value C(none) can be used during an update to remove this value.

options.name: os_version
options.description: Chassis partition F5OS-C OS version. The value C(none) can be used during an update to remove this value. This value must be in ISO format on the VELOS controller, otherwise you receive an illegal reference error message.

options.name: shared_volume
options.description: Partition shared volume size in GB.

options.name: slots
options.description: List (integers), specifies which slots with which the chassis partition should associated. By default, the chassis partition is not associated with any slots.

options.name: state
options.description: The chassis partition state. If C(absent), deletes the chassis partition if it exists. C(present) creates the chassis partition and enables it. If C(enabled), enables the chassis partition if it exists. If C(disabled), creates the chassis partition if needed, and sets state to C(disabled).

options.name: wait_time
options.description: Max number of seconds to wait after creating a chassis partition for it to transition to the 'running' state.
